allowSiteSelectionForActiveDirectoryAcco.description: Allows users to select a site when launching or generating proxy credentials for a RDP proxied secret

daysToKeepOperationalLogs.description: The number of days to store RDP proxy logs before they are rolled over

enableRdpProxy.description: Whether or not to enable the RDP proxy

enableRemoteHostValidation.description: Whether or not to enforce certificate validation on remote hosts that the proxy connects to

proxyNewSecretsByDefault.description: Whether or not new RDP-enabled secrets should be created with 'Proxy Enabled' set

rdpProxyPort.description: The port that the RDP proxy will run on

rdpServerCertificateMultipart.description: The certificate that is server when connections begin to the RDP proxy (used "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" only)

rdpServerCertificateMultipartPassword.description: The password used to protect the certificate (only used for updating with "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" only)

RdpProxyCertificateViewModel.description: The certificate that is server when connections begin to the RDP proxy (used "Content-Type: application/json" only)

rdpServerCertificate.description: The certificate (x509/pfx) that is served to users connecting to the RDP proxy.

rdpServerCertificateFileName.description: The name of the RDP server certificate file

rdpServerCertificatePassword.description: The password used to protect the certificate (only used for updating)
